model_answer: Taking the emergency contraceptive pill (ECP) like Unwanted 72 within 12 hours after intercourse significantly reduces the chance of pregnancy, but it is not 100% effective. If you have missed your period and suspect pregnancy, it is important to confirm this with a serum beta hCG test. If you are indeed pregnant, studies indicate that ECPs do not cause harm to the fetus, so it is generally safe to continue the pregnancy. However, given your recent history of abortion, it is advisable to consult with an obstetrician for personalized guidance and to ensure a healthy pregnancy.
gold_answer: Hello. The medical or chemical termination of pregnancy is safe and effective until 10 weeks. If it is beyond 12 weeks, surgical procedures may be required.
